request.style: English, Female soulful voice with soft choir backing, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, gentle drums, hopeful and pleading, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Shepherd of Israel, please hear us now
You lead Joseph like a flock
Enthroned upon the cherubim
Shine forth from your holy ground

[Verse]
Before Ephraim, Benjamin, Manasseh
Stir up your great might
Come and save us from the deep
Restore us in the light

[Chorus]
Restore us, O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
Restore us, O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved

[Verse]
LORD God of hosts, how long
Will your anger smolder
Against the prayer of your people
Waiting for the word

[Chorus]
Restore us, O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
Restore us, O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved

[Bridge]
Bread of tears and measure cups
We have drunk them all
Strife among our neighbors
Enemies laugh and call

[Chorus]
Restore us, O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
Restore us, O God
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved

[Outro]
Let your face shine on us
That we may be saved
